Hi Jasmine,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed by the latency numbers. Our procurement and risk teams have asked for 3-4 references (technical and security contacts) and any case study material you have for customers in data-heavy analytics workloads.

Timeline is tight: we’re aiming to complete reference calls the week of Nov 10 so the procurement committee can sign off before month-end. If you have customers who prefer not to take live calls, we can accept a short written Q&A or an approved one-page case study. Also, please flag any customers who typically decline reference requests so we can plan alternates.

Could you send a list and available windows by EOD Friday (Nov 7)? Also — our security team will likely request SOC 2 and a contact for technical audit questions.

Appreciate it,
Daniel

Thanks for the roster, Marissa. A few operational notes — please use the following playbook when customers decline or ask for fewer live sessions:

1) Offer a written Q&A (2–4 questions max) and an approved one-page case study (we have Greener’s exec-approved PDF)
2) When opting for a substitute, prefer customers who used the same model types (low-latency gen workloads); DataScout and CitrixX look good here
3) If a strategic buyer insists on exec-level references, offer a recorded 20–minute pre-approved conversation from a previous case study (where permitted) rather than scheduling a new live call

Also, let Nimbus know we can provide SOC 2 link and a technical contact for audit questions — that typically helps speed procurement. I’m cc’ing Solutions if they want to weigh in.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Sales Director | Redwood Inference
